messages.handover: Handover taken: running equipment, open permits and alarms noted
messages.round_done: Round done: readings in the log
messages.finding: Round finding: a reading out of its range, see the log
messages.check_alarm: Please check the alarm locally and report
messages.alarm_checked: Alarm checked locally: reported in the log
messages.permit_issued: Your permit is issued: you may accept it
messages.permit_closed: Permit closed: equipment back in service
messages.instruction: Instruction for you over the radio
messages.ccw_cooler_done: CCW cooler valves set as asked
messages.vents_done: Water box vents set as asked
messages.lock_left: Removed by authority: its holder went off shift with the work unfinished and nobody took it over
messages.locks_removed: A lock left by someone gone off shift removed by authority: see the permit
messages.job_assigned: A job for you: its permit is issued, accept it at the equipment
messages.cal_done: Calibration done: the transmitter reads true, permit handed back
messages.team_on: Contractors at work under their permit
messages.handed_back: Contractors' permits handed back: the work areas are clear
messages.stopped: Work stopped by HSE: an unsafe act
messages.need_permit: Reporting for a permit before I start
messages.walk_done: Safety walk done: findings in the log
messages.handover_wtp: WTP handover taken: running streams, tanks, open permits and alarms noted
messages.handover_lab: Laboratory handover taken: samples due and results noted
messages.round_done_wtp: WTP round done: readings in the log
messages.backwash_order: A filter is due: backwash it
messages.backwash_done: Filter backwashed and back in service
messages.regen_on: Mixed bed changed over: the exhausted bed is regenerating
messages.regen_done: Mixed bed regenerated and rinsed: in standby
messages.cip_on: RO train off line for its cleaning in place
messages.cip_done: RO train cleaned: in standby, the wastes neutralised
messages.ro_flushed: RO train tripped: flushed, waiting for the cause to be found
messages.samples_done: Samples analysed: results in the log
messages.stock_done: Chemical stock and dosing checked: results in the log
messages.delivery: Tank being filled from the bulk delivery
messages.demin_low: Demineralised water tank low at the train: more transfer please
messages.transfer_on: Transfer pumps running to the train's demineralised water tank
messages.prepared: Equipment out of service and safe for its isolation
